params.body:
`afrodidact.org` runs on its own machine behind nginx: no framework to hook, no Netlify to configure. Its headers are a line in a server block, and that line lives on a box this hand does not touch. But the project keeps its nginx config under version control (`deploy/nginx/sites-available/afrodidact.conf`) and copies it out on deploy, and there the header is a line in a file like any other.

**Third target `nginx`:** a `*.conf` under `deploy/nginx` that names the measured host in exactly one `server_name <host>;` line. The plan inserts the `add_header … always;` lines in that block (`always`, because a header that vanishes on an error page cannot be relied on).

**Two refusals keep it honest:**
- the config already uses `add_header` anywhere: nginx drops every inherited header the moment a location sets one of its own, so these lines would silently not reach every path
- the host is named in more than one block: which block serves it would be a guess

The deploy stays a person's (that project's README says `ssh root@… 'nginx -t \&\& systemctl reload nginx'`), so the claim waits for the measurement like any other.

646 tests, PHPStan, Pint.
params.title: The headers hand writes nginx too, when the repo carries the config
